parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A ball leaves point P at the top of a cliff with a horizontal velocity of 15 m s^{-1}, as shown in
Fig. 2.1.
The height of the cliff is 25 m. The ball hits the ground at point Q.
Air resistance is negligible.

vertical velocity = m s^{-1}
